# Protex repository instructions

For every coding, debugging, code-review, testing, or file-change task in this repository:

1. Read the complete `.agents/skills/protex/SKILL.md` before making changes.
2. Follow the Protex workflow and all applicable file-protection, scope, testing, verification, and reporting rules.
3. Read the relevant files under `.agents/skills/protex/references/` when the task involves safe file operations or test strategy.
4. Change only the files and code areas explicitly authorized by the user. Ask before deleting, moving, renaming, or destructively replacing existing files, or before expanding the authorized scope.
5. Preserve existing user changes and do not claim that tests or checks passed unless they were actually run and their results were observed.
6. At the end, report the exact files changed and the real test results, including checks that could not be run.

If the Protex skill file cannot be accessed, say so clearly and do not claim that Protex was loaded. Do not silently substitute an incomplete summary for the full skill.

These repository instructions and the Protex skill remain subordinate to higher-priority system, platform, and safety rules.
